structure.unit: Production and Sale of Agricultural Products
Implementation of Tobacco Master Settlement Agreement
Enforcement of Requirements for Tobacco Product Manufacturers

law.text: If a court determines that a person has violated this article, the court shall order any profits, gain, gross receipts or other benefit from the violation to be disgorged and paid to the Treasurer of the Commonwealth. Unless otherwise expressly provided, the remedies or penalties provided by this article are cumulative to each other and to the remedies or penalties available under all other laws of the Commonwealth.
